title: Subsets II

solutions.naive:
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def subsetsWithDup(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        found = set()
        path = []

        def dfs(i: int) -> None:
            if i == len(nums):
                found.add(tuple(sorted(path)))
                return
            dfs(i + 1)
            path.append(nums[i])
            dfs(i + 1)
            path.pop()

        dfs(0)
        return [list(s) for s in sorted(found)]
solutions.better:
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def subsetsWithDup(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        nums.sort()
        result = []
        path = []

        def backtrack(start: int) -> None:
            result.append(path.copy())
            prev = None
            for i in range(start, len(nums)):
                if nums[i] == prev:
                    continue
                prev = nums[i]
                path.append(nums[i])
                backtrack(i + 1)
                path.pop()

        backtrack(0)
        return result
